name: seat-picker
title: Seat Picker
description: A seat counter: armchairs that fill as you add seats, a rolling stepper and a badge of seats left.

perf.budget: Seat pops and the number roll run once per change on the UI thread; at rest nothing animates. All seats share one Skia canvas.

measurements.notes: Frame times are mostly the emulator GPU swap: framestats show about 6 ms of app work per frame (input, animation and drawing) and ~17 ms waiting for the swap.

a11y.reducedMotion: Seats fill and empty without popping, the number changes in place and the stepper does not shake.
a11y.screenReader: The count is an adjustable control ("2 seats"); the buttons are named Add a seat and Remove a seat; the badge reads "3 seats left" and is announced as it changes.
a11y.touchTarget: Stepper buttons and the action are 52 pt tall; the info button is 44 pt.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add seat-picker`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
